question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

14, 26, 11, ?, 8, 32
solution:
The logic followed here is :

There are two series in the given series;

Series 1: 14, 11, 8, .......

Series 2: 26, ? , 32, ...... 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d19c9fac77f61a6996d1ffe3b9100aedc21acef6ad4e45b46bd54eea0bde6ba.png] 

Hence,** 29** is the correct answer.
